judged_text: This group-memberships PR also restyles the badges admin form: the label/input-width rules were deleted from section.details .form-horizontal and re-added only under a new ".groups, .badges" scope, which is work not traceable to the stated intent. Any admin page that relied on the deleted section.details .form-horizontal rules without a .groups or .badges ancestor class (the badges details form, if its markup lacks a .badges wrapper) silently loses its 350px input widths and bold labels, and badges styling now changes in lockstep with unrelated group styling.

adjudication.rationale: The diff does move generic `.form-horizontal` styling (bold labels, `& > div` spacing, 350px input/select widths, checkbox width) out of `section.details .form-horizontal` and into a new `.groups, .badges { .form-horizontal { ... } }` scope in `admin_base.scss`. Those rules were deleted from `section.details` (lines removed around the `section.details .form-horizontal` block) and are no longer applied to other admin forms under `section.details` unless they have a `.groups` or `.badges` ancestor. That’s a real, diff-grounded scope change that could cause unintended styling regressions beyond group membership changes, but the specific claim about the badges form lacking a `.badges` wrapper cannot be verified from this diff alone.
